text: The singular values of a matrix A are defined as:
choices: the square roots of the eigenvalues of A*A
the absolute values of the eigenvalues of A
explanation: A*A is positive semidefinite, so its eigenvalues are ≥ 0 and have well-defined square roots σ₁ ≥ σ₂ ≥ ⋯ ≥ 0. Singular values coincide with |eigenvalues| only for normal matrices — e.g. [[0,1],[0,0]] has both eigenvalues 0 but singular values 1 and 0.
